text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before the URA Finale final race,<n>Trainer Kiryuin and
I meet and lock<n>eyes, ready to face off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her words echo the spirit and<n>passion of our two
rivals who have<n>overcome countless hurdles to
make<n>it to this point.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The final race of the URA Finale is<n>about to begin!
